issue_context.title: crash by var pos=Vector3(1.0,1.0,n)
issue_context.body:
Godot version:4.0
OS/device including version:mac os 10.15.6

Issue description: Crash

Steps to reproduce:

`
extends Node3D
func _ready():
	var n=10.0
	var pos=Vector3(1.0,1.0,n)
`
comments:
> Godot version:4.0 Since Godot 4.0 is constantly changing, please specify commit hash > `extends Node3D func _ready(): var n=10.0 var pos=Vector3(1.0,1.0,n)` This doesn't look formatted correctly.
